newsitem.title: USA: Wyser-Pratte says Rexene board must act.
newsitem.headline: Wyser-Pratte says Rexene board must act.

text.p: Dissident Rexene Corp shareholder Wyser-Pratte & Co Ltd said it believes that the time has come for the Rexene board to act in shareholders' interests and accept a $16 per share cash offer from Huntsman Corp.

"I wonder what the two newly appointed Rexene board members, Richard Parry and Stephen Swid, think of Rexene now. They must start to act as the eyes and ears of shareholders," said Eric Longmeire, managing director at Wyser-Pratte.
Wyser-Pratte and Spear, Leeds & Kellog control around 13 percent of Rexene shares.
Privately-held Huntsman said on Thursday that it could finance a deal, a matter which had been disputed by Rexene.

"The board has been wasting shareholder time and money, if they had done their own due diligence on Huntsman they would have seen the financing was there. A handshake from Jon Huntsman is worth more than a written contract with most other people," said Longmeire.
A spokesman for Rexene declined to comment on the company's response. ((-- David Chance New York Newsroom 212 859 1902))
